title: Storybound script
description: config/storybound/scripts/<path>.json — a script of vanilla commands, run in order by the action run_script (at the player, at the entity of the moment, or at an entity found by a selector), like an .mcfunction. A line 'wait <seconds>' pauses; a line starting with # is a note. Every command is checked when the story loads.

icon.description: Dev mode only: the item this node shows on the editor's canvases.

description.description: A note for the pack's authors: what the script does.

lines.description: The commands, one per line, without a leading slash: ~ ~ ~ is where the script runs. 'wait 2' pauses two seconds; '# ...' is a note.
